findings.explanation: The Cloud Scheduler job name is hardcoded as "backup-scheduler-trigger" while every other named resource in the module (Cloud Run job, both service accounts) derives its name from var.job_name. Cloud Scheduler job names must be unique within a project+region pair; deploying this module twice will fail on the second apply with a name conflict. A rule engine cannot detect this because it does not know that the module is designed to be reusable or that var.job_name is the intended naming key.
findings.remediation: Replace `name = "backup-scheduler-trigger"` with `name = "${var.job_name}-scheduler"` to match the naming convention used by every other resource in the module.
findings.title: Cloud Scheduler job name is hardcoded, preventing multiple module instantiations in the same project/region
